s.note: Corn chips with chorizo, beans, cheddar, guacamole and sour cream
s.how: Fry 2 diced chorizo until crisp. Warm 400g refried beans with 1 tsp cumin. Spread 300g corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and chorizo and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime, salt and coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, 150g sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.

s.note: Crispy chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, pickle ranch dip
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces and soak in 250ml dill pickle brine for 2 hours. Drain, dip in 1 beaten egg with 100ml buttermilk, then 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and salt. Fry at 175C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt. Mix 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp chopped pickles and dill for dipping.

m.note: Coconut green curry and rice. Alison's on with James Franco in the morning
m.how: Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp of the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, 100ml stock, 4 torn makrut lime leaves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar. Simmer 12 minutes, adding 150g snake beans for the last 5. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.

m.n: Roommates' pepperoni and hot honey pizza
m.note: Pepperoni, jalapeños and mozzarella on a crisp base, chilli honey and rocket on top
m.how: Heat the oven as high as it goes with two trays inside. Mix the passata with the garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt. Stretch the dough into 4 bases on baking paper, spread with the sauce and top with the mozzarella, pepperoni and jalapeños. Slide onto the hot trays and bake 8 to 10 minutes until blistered, two at a time. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes, drizzle over and finish with rocket and shaved parmesan.

w.note: Lemon and raspberry. Debbie and Pete make up at the party
w.how: Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar with lemon zest, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 cases for 18 minutes and cool. Fill each centre with raspberry jam (120g total). Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk, split in two and tint pale pink and pale blue. Pipe on and crumble over freeze-dried raspberries.

d.note: Grape juice, lime, soda water and mint over ice, no alcohol
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
